name: SameSalt
description: Help patients in India pay less for the same medicine. Given a photo of a medicine strip or a typed name (English, Kannada or Hindi): read the brand, salt(s) and strength; find every brand with exactly the same salt, strength and dosage form and rank them by price per tablet; show the matching Jan Aushadhi (PMBJP) generic and its official MRP; find the nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra from a PIN code; answer in the user's language. Never give dosage advice, never suggest switching narrow-therapeutic-index drugs (warfarin, thyroxine, epilepsy, transplant drugs), and always tell the user to check with their doctor or pharmacist before switching. Log each lookup anonymously for an impact dashboard.

plan.summary: Fixed, auditable tool plan. Models only read the photo / free text; every match, price and safety decision is a deterministic tool over published data. AF's first draft (browser scraping of retail sites) was replaced: scraping is fragile and SerpApi credits are gone, so production uses the 246k-brand database + official PMBJP lists.

steps.title: read_strip
steps.detail: Vision model reads brand, salts, strengths, form, release from the photo (prompt: read_strip). Fallback: mistral-small-3.1, then on-device Tesseract OCR in the browser.

steps.title: understand_text
steps.detail: Only for typed text in Kannada/Hindi script or full questions (prompt: understand_text).

steps.title: identify_medicine
steps.detail: Brand-name match with strict number check, cross-checked against the composition read off the strip; falls back to the composition alone.

steps.title: find_same_salt
steps.detail: All brands with an identical canonical key (sorted salts:strength | form | release), cheapest per unit first.

steps.title: jan_aushadhi_match
steps.detail: PMBJP generic with the identical key and its official MRP.

steps.title: nearest_kendra
steps.detail: Nearest Kendras by location or PIN (exact, then nearby PINs).

steps.title: compose_answer
steps.detail: Answer in en/kn/hi from verified facts only; safety line always; NTI drugs never get a switch suggestion.

steps.title: log_lookup
steps.detail: Anonymous impact row (no image, name, phone, IP); test traffic flagged and excluded.

afDraftSteps.title: Confirm inputs, constraints and consent
afDraftSteps.detail: Ask user to confirm they will upload a photo or type the medicine name, provide PIN code and preferred language, and to consent to anonymous logging for the impact dashboard.

afDraftSteps.title: Request required user data
afDraftSteps.detail: Prompt user to upload a clear photo of the medicine strip OR type the brand name and salt(s) with strength and dosage form, plus the 6-digit PIN and preferred language (English/Kannada/Hindi).

afDraftSteps.title: Save raw user input to working folder
afDraftSteps.detail: Write the uploaded image filename or the typed text, PIN and language to a timestamped file in the working folder for processing (local storage).

afDraftSteps.title: Extract text from photo (if image provided)
afDraftSteps.detail: If the user provided a photo, run local OCR (e.g., Tesseract) on the saved image to extract printed text from the strip; do not upload the image externally unless user explicitly allows.

afDraftSteps.title: Parse and normalize medicine fields
afDraftSteps.detail: From OCR/text input, identify brand name, active salt(s) (INN), strengths, dosage form (tablet/capsule/syrup), and pack size; transliterate/translate from Kannada/Hindi to English for matching, normalize units (mg, mcg).

afDraftSteps.title: Check narrow-therapeutic-index (NTI) exclusions
afDraftSteps.detail: Compare the parsed salts against an NTI/exclusion list (e.g., warfarin, levothyroxine, antiepileptics, transplant/immunosuppressants) and flag if switching should NOT be suggested; include mandatory safety rule.

afDraftSteps.title: Search Indian drug registries and retail sites for exact matches
afDraftSteps.detail: Query authoritative sources (CDSCO product lists, PMBJP/Jan Aushadhi site, major retailers and pharma price aggregators like 1mg, PharmEasy, Netmeds, MedIndia, PharmaTrac) for brands whose active salt(s), strength and dosage form exactly match the parsed values.

queries: Exact match search: "<salt name> <strength> <dosage form> site:1mg.com OR site:pharmeasy.in OR site:netmeds.com"
args.notes: Prefer official/regulatory sources first, then large retailers for current retail MRPs.

afDraftSteps.title: Extract prices and compute price-per-tablet
afDraftSteps.detail: For every matching brand found, collect packaging (tablets per pack) and retail price to calculate price per tablet; note currency (INR) and any pack-size differences.

args.instructions: Scrape or read displayed MRP/retail price and pack size from each listing; record source URL and timestamp.

afDraftSteps.title: Rank brands by price per tablet and compute savings
afDraftSteps.detail: Sort matching brands by computed price per tablet (ascending), compute absolute and percentage savings versus the user's current brand, and flag any price outliers or unverified entries.

afDraftSteps.title: Lookup PMBJP (Jan Aushadhi) generic and official MRP
afDraftSteps.detail: Search the PMBJP/Jan Aushadhi database for the exact matching generic formulation, capture the official PMBJP MRP and availability notes.

queries: Retrieve official PMBJP MRP and pack sizes

afDraftSteps.title: Find nearest Jan Aushadhi Kendra for user's PIN
afDraftSteps.detail: Using the user's 6-digit PIN, query the PMBJP/Jan Aushadhi locator or government listings to find the nearest Kendra(s), addresses, and contact details.

args.query: Jan Aushadhi Kendra locator search by PIN <PIN>

afDraftSteps.title: Draft user-facing reply in the user's language with safety disclaimers
afDraftSteps.detail: Compose a message in the requested language showing: parsed brand/salt/strength/form, ranked brands with price-per-tablet and savings, the PMBJP generic and its official MRP, nearest Kendra details, and mandatory safety text: do not give dosage advice, do not suggest switching NTI drugs, and advise checking with doctor/pharmacist before switching.

args.output_template: Include translation/localized terms and the exact disclaimer phrasing; ask if user wants purchase links or help contacting the Kendra.

afDraftSteps.title: Save a local copy of the results
afDraftSteps.detail: Write the anonymized result summary and the raw matched-brand list to a timestamped file in the working folder for traceability.

args.content: { "parsed": { /* brand/salt/strength/form */ }, "matches": [ /* brands, price_per_tablet, source_url */ ], "pmbjp": { /* generic, mrp */ }, "nearest_kendra": { /* address */ }, "language": "<lang>" }

afDraftSteps.title: Log anonymized lookup to impact dashboard
afDraftSteps.detail: Send a minimal anonymized record (salt(s), strength, dosage form, timestamp, hashed PIN or rounded PIN area, language) to the external impact dashboard endpoint for aggregate metrics tracking; do not include any PII or user identifiers.

args.note: Use POST with TLS; ensure payload contains no names, contact info, or raw PIN. Confirm user consent before sending.

afDraftSteps.title: Return the drafted results to the user
afDraftSteps.detail: Present the localized message and ask whether the user wants purchase links, directions to the Kendra, or help contacting the Kendra/pharmacist; reiterate the safety disclaimers.

dataAccess: official PMBJP product and Kendra lists
actions: append one anonymous row to the impact log
rules: Same salt + same strength + same dosage form + same release type only.
Never give dosage advice or advise stopping a medicine.
Narrow-therapeutic-index salts (warfarin, thyroxine, antiepileptics, transplant drugs, lithium, digoxin...) never get a switch suggestion.
Every answer ends with: check with your doctor or pharmacist before switching.
Photos are processed in memory and never stored; no personal data in logs.
guardrails.tone: plain, short, respectful; patient's chosen language (English, Kannada, Hindi)
